core.title: Folger Adam Electric Strike, HES 310-4
tags: HES -310-4-24D Electric Strike for Pullman Style Latchbolts

text.description_html:
HES 310-4-24D, HES Folger Adam 310-4 Electric Strike

The all stainless steel construction of the Folger Adam Electric Strike makes it ideal for high abuse applications that would disable other electric strikes. The HES Folger Adam 310-4 Series has a unique 3/4 inch face plate with an integrated 1/4 inch base shim that can be removed in the field to accommodate rim exit devices with a 1/2 inch or 3/4 inch throw latchbolt. For up to 3/4 inch [19mm] Pullman style latchbolts on single doors. UL10C,3-hour fire rated. UL1034 burglary resistant listed. ANSI/BHMA A156.31 Grade 1 certified.

Non-Handed, reversible for left or right hand doors. Can be used with wood or metal frames. Includes installation hardware and template.

Features for the HES -310-4-24D Electric Strike for Pullman Style Latchbolts:

  • Stainless steel construction
  • Voltage 24 VDC
  • Endurance 1 million cycles
  • Tamper resistant
  • Fail secure or fail safe operation.

Specifications for the HES FolgerAdam 310-4 Electric Strike:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless
  • Faceplate 1-3/4" x 9" with square corners
  • Static Strength: 1,500 lbs.
  • Dynamic Strength: 70 ft. lbs.
  • Accommodates 1/2" - 3/4" latchbolt
  • Non-Handed (reversible)
  • HES 310-4 Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually
